00053     :   numInputs_(numInputs),

00074         audioDeviceManager.removeAudioCallback(this); // try this first to prevent deadlock? nope - now crashes here

00083     void timerCallback()
00084     {
00085         stopTimer();
00086         
00087         String error = audioDeviceManager.initialise (numInputs_, numOutputs_, 0, true);
00088         
00089         if (error.isNotEmpty())
00090         {
00091             AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00092                                          T("JuceIOHost"), 
00093                                          T("AudioDeviceManager failed \n\n") + error);
00094         }
00095         else 
00096         {
00097             const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00098             
00099             if(numInputs_ > 0)

00101             audioDeviceManager.addAudioCallback (this);

00111     void audioDeviceIOCallback (const float** inputChannelData,
00112                                 int numInputChannels, 
00113                                 float** outputChannelData, 
00114                                 int numOutputChannels, 
00115                                 int numSamples)
00116     {
00117         // may need to be a bit cleverer with the channels in here..
00118         const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00119         int blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(numSamples);
00120         
00121         if(numInputs_ > 0)
00122             input_.setInputs(inputChannelData, numSamples, numInputChannels);
00123         
00124         if(numOutputs_ > 0)
00125         {
00126             output_.setOutputs(outputChannelData, numSamples, numOutputChannels);
00127             output_.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00128         }
00129         
00130         for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00131         {
00132             others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00133         }
00134     }
